title: Iraj Castle

terrainReference.basis: Original grade outside the southwestern wall near the mapped track through the enclosure.

mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap way 406667535 and its four independently measured corner coordinates. Preserve the mapped axes and leave the historic interior open.

note: The measured wall lower section consists of battered rammed earth with mudbrick above. Use the recurring eroded rounded embankments and openings in the cleared southwestern view, with original elevation profiles on all four walls.
